notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_8XtlmpqTqs

Greetings! Beta update 2.6.0 has just been released, major changes include:

[list]
[*]New terrains: Updated level design / terrains for base camp and storm maps.
[*]Added Loading screen maps (will be updated to show where player is located)
[*]Updated Field Of View (setting will be added to options in upcoming updates)
[*]New models, materials, textures & art
[*]Updated sounds, scenery, cinematics, explosions, post-processing effects, particles…
[*]Added and tested new navmesh, collissions, pathways, triggers, blueprints…
[*]Temporary removed harbor and university maps
[*]Fixed LOD flickering lights at mountains map
[*]Updated Cthulhu’s tentacle physics
[*]Updated jurassic map (lighting, effects, scenery)
[*]Updated inventory tasks
[*]Updated Shoggoth cinematic (voice volume, character glitch)
[*]Fixed several visual glitches
[*]Fixed a bug where the player character wasn’t teleporting at final scene
[*]Fixed a bug where the player character wasn’t teleporting at permafrost scene
[*]Fixed a bug where the player character was stuck at cave map[/list]

Please take in count that with every new update new glitches and errors are expected to appear, if you experience any issue during gameplay please report it at the forums / website, thanks in advance!

notes.title: Beta updated to version 2.4
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18283588/f7086c75a436d3b77ac5b793a5b59df96fdf7de0.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18283588/c8c8503def148c9c08862e87024c5068eea8dde2.png[/img][/url]

[b]Changes and adjustments[/b]

Postprocess settings have been set to High by default at game start, adjust or disable if you have low performance when playing (mostly on old hardware)

Player will no longer die at "highjump" platforms of the Mountains map. When falling from a platform player respawns at the top and can start jumping again

Adjusted visual and sound effect when sprinting and when exhausted. Also no longer running sound is heard while player is not running (when Sprint key is pressed but energy is too low to run)

LOD's have been rebuilt and activated at remaining levels

2nd procedural maze has been removed for now

[b]Additions[/b]

Added Boston harbor's market scenery

Added new 3D Models (fossils, scenery, terrain, characters, items...)

[b]Major bugs fixed[/b]

Fixed a bug where keys weren't opening doors properly at Mountains map

Fixed a bug where the cave wasn't collapsing once you had taken the fossil

Fixed a bug where morse code wasn't stopping after message was read

Fixed a bug where same NPC was appearing 2 times in the same map

Fixed a bug where it was snowing inside the cabin

Fixed a bug where some texts weren't appearing on screen

Fixed a bug where the player was still freezing while watching some cutscenes

Fixed a bug where Danforth was repeating his sentence annoyingly at Lake's Camp

Aside from lots of minor changes and fixes: shorten first cutscene, changes in lighting of some scenes, adjusted timing of a few texts, changes and improvements on some textures, adjustments on a few cutscenes, updated credits...

Enjoy & have a nice summer!

notes.title: New Trailer + Update 2.3
notes.content:
Greetings, here are the details form the latest update and link to watch our new Beta Trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z4Awad3Kc70

Update Log

Updated Freezing Mechanic:
-Now freezing will only affect stamina and movement speed.
-Fixed snow effect over player character as player freezes.
-Updated freezing visual effect: the effect of freezing now gradually appears on the screen as the player freezes and provides a visual indication
-Fixed overlap of the freezing effect so that the player can always use the inventory without problems.
-Updated player character movement & collision to make it more fluid.

-Added NPC name texts above their heads
-Fixed Burning fire/damage:
Smaller fire damage range.
-Prevent burning more than once at a time
-Aside from lots of minor fixes and updates such as dates and other texts, timings of some texts that couldn’t be read, some objects in the world, updated LODs, blocking volumes updated…

Thank you very much for purchasing the game. Enjoy the update and stay tuned!

notes.title: Beta Update v2.1
notes.content:
Greetings, we have just released the beta Update version 2.1 wich comes with a lot of fixes and improvements to the game stability :)

-New Models & Animations
-Fixed low framerate issues
-FPS cap to 60+
-Load/Save map system updated
-New Inventory system
-Fixed unicode missing characters issue at some languages
-New font
-Fixed Audio/SFX and attenuation issues
-Disabled level streaming
-General fixes: pick-ups,flashlight,lighting,mechanics...

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
Greetings
We have just uploaded a performance update with around 4Gb of pre-built light maps allowing more hardware compatibility.
Be sure to have all your graphic drivers updated, about the framerate there is a cap actually so if the game runs smooth at 30-40 FPS it is working as intended for now, there are some areas where you could drop some frames but we will have this solved asap and also will look into a unbound framerate for upcoming updates.

Thanks a lot for your support and feedback, if anything please head into the discussion forums :)

Regards
